# 👋 Hi, I'm [Mirthe](https://github.com/mirthhe)

## About Me  
I'm a creative and curious developer with a diverse background in **frontend development**, **UI/UX design**, **bioinformatics**, and **data science**. My goal is to make complex concepts accessible — sparking curiosity and sharing knowledge through thoughtful, user-centered design and clean, expressive code. 💡🌐

## What I Do  
- **UI/UX Design & Front-End Development:** Passionate about crafting intuitive user experiences through design systems, accessibility-first thinking, and responsive, well-documented, semantic code. 🎨🖱️💻  

- **Data Visualization & Data Design:** Making the complex appear simple by transforming data into visuals that inform and inspire. 📊🧠✨  

- **Bioinformatics & Scientific Software:** With an academic foundation in bioinformatics and data science, I build tools that support medical and biological research. 🔬🧬🧪  

- **Tech Stack:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, R, Python, Bash, Git, and AI tools like LLMs & RAG — always learning and iterating. ⚙️👩‍💻🛠️  

## Current Projects  
As UI/UX & Bioinformatics Developer at Maastricht University and University of Applied Sciences Utrecht, I'm currently developing standardized software for the creation of **Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetic (PBPK)** models and leading the **UI/UX design** for VHP4Safety. This work combines code and design to enable more transparent and accessible toxicology modeling. The repository is private, but feel free to reach out if you're curious or want to collaborate!  

I'm also working on re-launching my portfolio and actively expanding my skills in front-end frameworks (such as React and Bootstrap), alongside a few playful side projects. 🚀

## Outside the Screen  
When I'm not designing interfaces or wrangling code, you'll likely find me exploring nature trails, gaming, or reading up on human behavior and design psychology. I believe great design starts with empathy and real-world inspiration. 🌿📚

## Let's Connect!  
I'm always open to new ideas, collaborations, or just a good chat about tech, design, or science. Whether you're building a product, visualizing data, or prototyping research tools — let’s connect and create something meaningful together! 🤝✨
